claims: Tottenham Hotspur played Atletico Madrid in the UEFA Champions League on March 18, 2026.
Tottenham Hotspur used a 5-4-1 formation.
Atletico Madrid used a 4-4-2 formation.
Tottenham Hotspur won 3-2.
Atletico Madrid advanced 7-3 on aggregate.
Tottenham Hotspur's starting goalkeeper was Guglielmo Vicario.
Tottenham Hotspur's starting defenders were Pedro Porro, Cristian Romero (c), Radu Drăgușin, Micky van de Ven, Djed Spence.
Tottenham Hotspur's starting midfielders were Xavi Simons, Pape Matar Sarr, Archie Gray, Mathys Tel.
Tottenham Hotspur's starting forward was Randal Kolo Muani.
Tottenham Hotspur's substitutes were Kinsky, Austin, Danso, Udogie, Bergvall, Gallagher, Olusesi, Kyerematen, Rowswell.
Atletico Madrid's starting goalkeeper was Juan Musso.
Atletico Madrid's starting defenders were Nahuel Molina, Robin Le Normand, Dávid Hancko, Matteo Ruggeri.
Atletico Madrid's starting midfielders were Giuliano Simeone, Marcos Llorente, Johnny Cardoso, Ademola Lookman.
Atletico Madrid's starting forwards were Julián Alvarez, Antoine Griezmann.
Atletico Madrid's substitutes were Koke, Álex Baena, A. Sørloth, J. Giménez, N. González.
Igor Tudor started a back-five for Tottenham Hotspur.
Cristian Romero and Micky van de Ven returned to the lineup for Tottenham Hotspur.
Dominic Solanke missed the match due to a small problem.
Randal Kolo Muani led the line for Tottenham Hotspur.
Atletico Madrid were without goalkeeper Jan Oblak due to a muscle strain.
